source_failure_input.donor_observation: VoiceMem remember() daemon-thread start is not durable commit; abrupt process exit can lose the write.

current_f2_source_observations.observation: WP300 is explicitly persistence-agnostic. MemoryLifecycleState and MemoryTransitionReceipt fence memory_id/generation/state digest but the receipt classification explicitly does not grant persistence authority and the module performs no UnifiedDB reads/writes.
WP303 binds typed Fact/Episode/Method/Process metadata to an exact lifecycle-state identity but explicitly performs no UnifiedDB reads/writes and therefore cannot prove durable memory commit.

WP206 demonstrates an existing canonical-UnifiedDB checkpoint persistence pattern for Agency state, but its owned contract is persistent agency checkpoint/replay, not a general memory WriteIntent/WriteReceipt store. Generation 2 is currently claimed by another worker for a distinct authority-receipt replay defect and must not be overloaded by D15.

WP103 provides a repository-local example of canonical UnifiedDB-backed durable state/idempotency for recipient delivery, but it owns delivery lifecycle rather than memory persistence and must remain a donor pattern only.

Canonical Phase 3 currently enumerates WP300..WP306 and contains no dedicated durable memory-write persistence workpackage. WP904 exists canonically in Phase 9 as Failure injection/root-cause closure but has no active claim or implementation and is not the present memory-store owner.

invariants: A caller-visible success cannot be emitted before CANONICAL_COMMITTED is durably recorded for the exact write identity.
Restart must classify every previously admitted write identity as committed or explicitly non-committed/failed; UNKNOWN cannot be silently promoted to committed.
Retry must be idempotent by exact write/causal identity and must not duplicate a canonical memory record.
Projection/index/vector completion is distinct from canonical memory commit and may remain pending without losing canonical durability.
Shutdown must drain, cancel with explicit non-commit receipt, or preserve retryable durable intent; daemon-thread disappearance is never completion evidence.
The implementation must use the existing canonical UnifiedDB authority rather than create a second truth store.
Lifecycle status, typed-memory kind, retrieval relevance and effect authority remain separate from persistence commitment.

next_executable_discriminator.precondition: current owner/architect authority assigns the smallest canonical implementation owner without overloading an accepted unrelated workpackage
test_matrix: enqueue then immediate process exit before worker start
exit after STARTED but before canonical transaction commit
exit immediately after canonical commit but before projection/index completion
retry same causal identity with identical payload
retry same write_id with mismatched payload/digest must fail closed
shutdown with pending writes must resolve each identity to drained commit or explicit non-commit state
next_executable_discriminator.promotion_rule: Repository subprocess/restart fixtures may establish component persistence semantics only. Target/VPS/runtime, whole-system, effect and completion credit remain zero until their own exact-source gates execute.

counterhypothesis: The product may intentionally defer durable memory storage to a later integrated persistence owner, so absence of a current store is an incomplete architecture surface rather than a defect in WP300/WP303. This is why no accepted workpackage is reopened by this review.
evidence_boundary: Source/ledger review only. No host/model/provider execution, no memory write was performed, and no runtime/whole-system acceptance is implied.
